CustomField.description:
The customer is registered for with the Qantas Business Rewards loyalty program (previously Aquire). This calculates eligibility for airline discounts
STME-2670 Changes on Eligibility all Amex customers are GST registered and will have an eligible entity type, so therefore we do not need to check this
Changes on Dec 28.12.2016 --> Updated the Dates to (2016,12,12) for simulating the test Records End to End.Need to be changed to (2017,2,1) once testing done
CustomField.formula: IF (NOT(ISPICKVAL(Aquire_Override__c,'Y')), IF ( Aquire_System__c = true, IF (ISPICKVAL(Agency__c, 'N'), IF (SME_Deal__c = false, IF (ISPICKVAL(Dealing_Flag__c, 'N'), IF ( Aquire_Enrollment_Date_System__c >= DATE(2017,02,01) && AMEX__c != true , IF (ISPICKVAL(GST_Registered__c, 'N'), IF (Valid_Entity_Type__c = 'N','Not a Valid Entity or GST Registered', ''),'' ), ''), 'Corporate Deal'), ''), 'Industry is Travel'), 'Not QBR Member'), 'Manual Override')
CustomField.label: Primary Reason Not Eligible
